title: Sports Watch — schema v1
description: A small, secondary watchlist rendered under the AI briefing: what's live, close, or worth setting an alarm for, with JST times. Deliberately NOT a news feed — it exists so Joesh (in Japan) doesn't lose touch with the events he can't easily follow there.

dateLabel.description: JST label of when this scan ran, e.g. 'Tue · Sep 8 2026'.

status.description: live = in progress / final round today · upcoming = set an alarm · result = just finished, worth knowing.

event.description: The specific event or fixture, e.g. 'US Open final — Alcaraz vs Sinner'.

line.description: 1-2 sentences: the state of play and what's at stake. No padding.

whenJst.description: When it happens in JST so it's actually watchable from Japan, e.g. 'Sun Sep 13 · 05:00 JST'. Omit for a finished result.
